mgr.unofficial_fan_tool_ruse_mod:
Unofficial fan tool. RUSE Mod Manager is not made by or connected to Eugen Systems, the studio behind R.U.S.E. Game names belong to their owners.

It edits game files on your own computer, always making a backup first. Use it at your own risk — there is no warranty (GPL-3.0).

Privacy: the app does not track you or collect personal information. The packaged app asks GitHub once at startup whether a newer version exists; that sends nothing about you and never sends your files or mods. Running from source does not check for updates.
